name: Feedback Bot with Clone System
description: A Telegram feedback bot with clone system - users can create their own clone bots

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash from my.telegram.org

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram User ID (main sudo - has access to all clone bots too)

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Telegram channel/group ID for logging new users

AUTH_USERS.description: Space-separated list of additional sudo user IDs

START_TEXT.value: I am a Feedback Bot! Send me a message and the owner will reply.

HELP_TEXT.value: Send any message and the owner will receive it directly.

BROADCAST_AS_COPY.description: Set True to broadcast as copy (without forward tag)
